candidates.rules_primary: If Each Yes contract pays $0.05 per reception recorded by Stefon Diggs during the Washington vs New York G Pro Football game originally scheduled for Nov 12, 2026. candidates.rules_secondary:

For example, 8 receptions pays Yes $0.40 and No $0.60; 11 receptions pays Yes $0.55 and No $0.45; zero receptions pay Yes $0.00 and No $1.00.
